Select distinct molecule chembl_id, compound_name, and canonical_smiles for all molecules mentioned in document CHEMBL1123558. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then to docs on doc_id, and to compound_structures on molregno. Filter by docs.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1123558' and require canonical_smiles to be not null. Order results by chembl_id, compound_name, and canonical_smiles.
